title: Rank Networks
shortDescription: Rank Networks is a powerful tool designed to tackle the complexities of network ranking and provider selection, especially within managed care environments.
body: Rank Networks is a powerful tool designed to tackle the complexities of network ranking and provider selection, especially within managed care environments. It enables users to generate prioritized lists of key providers—such as physicians, hospitals, and medical groups—for use by brokers, consultants, and key decision—makers. ### Key Features: * **Provider-Based Network Ranking:** Ranks networks based on the number of providers within each network and helps you identify the most suitable options. * **Drug Inclusion Capabilities:** Supports network rankings that incorporate drug availability, allowing brokers to evaluate carriers based on formulary choices and share relevant insights with employees. * **Scalable for All Group Sizes:** Built to serve both small and large employer groups, offering a practical alternative to disruption analysis for smaller organizations that may lack access to advanced analytics. ### Accessing Rank Networks Rank Networks can be accessed from the left-hand sidebar navigation panel by clicking on Sales Tools or Broker Tools and then selecting the Rank Networks option. ### Creating a Ranking The landing page for Rank Networks contains two fields, Client and Name. **Client** – Indicates the client’s name for which you want to create a Ranking. **Name** – Indicates the name of the Ranking. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/creating-new-ranking.png) 1. Type the client's name into the Client text field. A list of existing clients associated with the project will appear as you type. • To select an existing client, simply choose from the dropdown list. • To create a new client, press the Enter key after typing the name. This allows you to quickly add or select clients. 2. In the Name text field, enter the desired name for your Ranking. 3. Click the Save button to store the Ranking. The Rank Networks page displays a pop-up message indicating that the Network Ranking is saved and the page displays the following options: • Search for the providers or facilities in the selected state that are important to the client and add them to the list. • Review the rankings below to see which networks have the most participating providers. • A button to create a new ranking (Create New Ranking). • Edit the client’s name or ranking name already created by clicking on Edit button. • Delete the created Ranking by clicking on Delete button. • Share the Ranking results. Searching and Adding Providers or Facilities: 1. Ente r the name of a provider or facility in the search field. Click on the Find Providers button. Note: Selecting a state is optional. However, choosing a specific state can help narrow down your results for more targeted search outcomes. The list of providers that match the characters entered in the search field will appear on the right side of the screen. 2. Click on the + sign to add providers whose ranking is to be compared. Once added, a confirmation pop-up will appear, and the + icon will change to a red X, indicating the provider has been selected for comparison. Removing a Provider from Ranking Comparison: To exclude a provider from the ranking comparison, click the red X icon (as shown in the figure above). Once a provider is selected, the ranking results will update to show the comparison. You can see the ranking results under the search and provider list. Additional providers can be added to compare their rankings. An example of when more than one provider is added to the ranking comparison list is shown below: Understanding Ranking Results The ranking results are displayed in 4 tabs. • Best Networks • Ranking Details • Selected Providers • Excluded Providers Best Networks Tab This default tab displays a list of networks derived from the project data. The percentages indicate the proportion of selected providers included in each network. Please refer to the screenshot above for more details. Ranking Details Tab This tab lists the Networks with the decreasing order of Ranking for the Physicians, Hospital, Groups, Not in Network and Provider Match %. The Physicians, Hospitals and Groups columns compare the number of each to the total number of Providers available in the Project Network. For example, consider PrimeHealth PPO. 3/4 value in Physicians column indicates that 3 out of 4 physicians are present in PrimeHealth PPO and 1 physician is not in network. The value corresponds to 75%. Adding providers indicates changes in the values present in the above table. Selected Providers Tab This tab lists the names of Providers added, their Specialty Groups, Last Added by (name of the person who added the provider in the ranking comparison), Last Added (date) and Times Added (number of times the specific provider was added). Excluded Networks Tab This tab lists the names of networks which were excluded from Ranking. Networks can be excluded in the following two ways: • To exclude a provider from the ranking comparison, click the red X icon to the right side of each provider in the list of providers displayed. The removed provider gets added to the Excluded Networks list. • Clicking on the settings link navigates to Home>Settings>Network Ranking tab. Click on + Add Network Exclusion. Type the first few characters of the network you want to exclude or click on the dropdown of the project field. After selecting the project from the list, Networks field displays. Select the network you want to exclude. Click on Add Network Exclusion. A success message gets displayed. The selected network is added to the excluded networks list. Sharing Ranking Results Clicking on the Share button opens a pop-up with the link to the ranking results page in the text box and a Share via Email button. The link can be copied and pasted as needed. Or click on the Share via Email button to automatically generate an email with a subject line and content. Simply add recipients. Alternatively, click on the dropdown arrow of the Share button to select other methods to share the ranking results. Share Results: Clicking on Share Results is the same as clicking the Share button directly. This is the default option. Send Survey: Clicking on Send Survey opens a pop-up with a link to the survey and a Share via Email button. The link can be copied and pasted as needed. Clicking the Share via Email button generates an email with a subject line and content. Simply add recipients. The Employee Survey can be used to send the rank network to a participant. The recipient of the survey will be able to add providers, facilities, drugs (if it's enabled) to the rank network analysis. These are in addition to any existing selections that were made in the original analysis. The participant providing this information is anonymous. Export as PDF: Clicking on Export as PDF initiates the export process to create a PDF of the Ranking Results. .. A message is displayed stating that the export was initiated. When the results are ready, a popup with Download results link is displayed and an email with a link to download the PDF is sent. Export Selected Providers: Clicking on Export Selected Providers initiates the export process. A message is displayed stating that the export was initiated. When the results are ready, a popup with Download results link is displayed and you can download the .csv file. An email with a link to download the .csv file is sent.
